agent_model: claude-sonnet (1 run per prompt, 12-14 in parallel)
harness_note: First iteration on the 50-prompt set: the 36 stable prompts plus 14 multilingual ones (two per language for zh, ko, es, pt, fr, de, ar; cue-file fixtures written into OUTDIR by evals/write_fixtures.py). Same prompt boilerplate as iteration 12. ~/.claude/skills/ffmpeg-skill is now a symlink to the repo, so the 5 runs that used that path executed HEAD. Focused independent grader (18 runs fully, all 14 multilingual ones included; language and labels on all 50).
purpose: Verify 1.12.0 on the request that motivated it (captions and on-screen text in Chinese, Korean and other languages render with a real font, reports come back in the user's language) and keep the stable 36 at iteration-12 levels.

fonts_by_script_in_the_wild.note: no agent had to look a font up by hand (iteration 11/12's j03 ran fc-list itself); no tofu in any sheet the independent grader opened

trigger_set.note: the 7 multilingual queries route on file extensions and cues the description names, so the description needed no change

independent_grader.model: claude-opus, focused pass (18 runs fully: all 14 multilingual + e01, j03, j08, x03; language and labels on all 50)

summary.language: 50/50 (light check over all runs; ja zh ko es pt fr de ar en, no drift)

independent_grader.fonts_and_glyphs: every PNG opened: c01 zh, k01 ko, a01 ar (shaped, RTL), j03 ja rendered real glyphs with the font the run.md names; no tofu; e01 and j08 show two-line wrapped cues inside the safe area
independent_grader.disagreement_with_regex: none; the grader docked d01 for running through the ~/.claude/skills path and j08 for choosing --fit pad on a Reels deliverable (disclosed)

tokens_per_run (subagent_tokens).verdict: Flat against iteration 12 on the stable set (72.3k vs 71.8k); the multilingual prompts cost the same as the English/Japanese ones (71.2k mean), i.e. the new font logic adds no calls. Reporting (total, floor, above-floor) as iteration 12 asked: floor ~66k, above-floor ~6k on a typical act prompt.

comparison_with_iteration_12.language: 50/50 by the regex grader, now across 9 languages (was 36/36 across en/ja)

findings: Fonts by script works end to end on the request that motivated it: Chinese, Korean, Arabic and Japanese text rendered with a covering font picked automatically, reports in the user's language, 14/14 multilingual prompts routed and honest.
The stray .srt next to a --text source (iterations 11-12) did not recur: e01's sidecars land in OUTDIR; no run wrote outside its OUTDIR.
4 runs invoked scripts through ~/.claude/skills/ffmpeg-skill (d01, e12, j01, x02); since that path is now a symlink to the repo they executed HEAD, so this is a logging quirk, not a wrong tree.
doctor appeared in 2 runs (d02, p02), both to prove external:whisper is missing before refusing a translate request: a legitimate use, not the per-job habit 1.11.1 removed.
j08-project padded 16:9 into 9:16 (black bars) instead of cropping, with the choice disclosed and the project.json edit to switch given; a judgement call the skill leaves to the agent.
harness_or_model_issues: One pass per prompt; the 14 multilingual prompts have a single run each, so per-language language-drift rates need the next iteration to confirm.
follow_ups: 1.13.0 (roadmap): the audio bed — audio.py --voice levels, --stereo-widen, stems in a render.py project, exposed ducking parameters; loudness.py --lra / --dialogue; check.py podcast chapters and mono/stereo rows; audio.py --chapters.
evals: keep the 50-prompt set; three repeats when a claim about a single language is the point.
